description: Send a command to a physical Afferens node. Use this to trigger actions on hardware — capture a camera frame, sound an alarm, move to coordinates, rotate a camera, lock or unlock, adjust a sensor, or shut down a node. Costs 5 Sense Tokens per command. Requires AFFERENS_API_KEY.

command_type.description: The command to execute on the target node.

parameters.description: Optional command-specific parameters (e.g. coordinates for MOVE_TO, angle for ROTATE_CAMERA).

target_node_id.description: ID of the node to command (e.g. IPHONE-IOS-01, CAM-ENTRY-02).

name: afferens_actuate
